source_title: All 13 Star Trek Movies Will Be Available to Stream Free Very Soon in Honor of Patrick Stewart
source_excerpt:
Home » All 13 Star Trek Movies Will Be Available to Stream Free Very Soon in Honor of Patrick Stewart
Fans can soon revisit the Star Trek film series on streaming as part of a special tribute to Patrick Stewart . The late actor famously portrayed Jean-Luc Picard in the beloved franchise.
All 13 movies in the Star Trek film series will arrive for streaming on Pluto TV beginning November 1. The feature films will be available on the platform for free but only for a limited time.
The special streaming event comes as part of Star Trek’s 60th-anniversary celebrations, which also serves as an opportunity to honor franchise star Sir Patrick Stewart following his recent passing.
Patrick Stewart stars in four of the 13 returning Star Trek films
Patrick Stewart made his debut as the USS Enterprise commanding officer Jean-Luc Picard in the 1987 television series Star Trek: The Next Generation. He reprised his role in the movies Star Trek Generations, Star Trek: First Contact, Star Trek: Insurrection, and Star Trek: Nemesis. These four movies are part of the franchise’s Next Generation film series, which followed the original six-film run.
The Star Trek franchise began in the 60s with Star Trek: The Original Series, before expanding to feature film series and television shows spanning different generations and rebooted versions.
